text_block_list.text:
To let Tap Dance City rest since she wasn't feeling well,
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
I think I'll lower my sails for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...What? What happened!?
When did I get on stage!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I don't really get it, but let's dance!
We already know what to do on stage anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
……, …….
—Wait, I can't…… do my steps?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with my legs...!
Come on, move like you always do!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, Tap-chan.
Now this is quite a rare sight..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There, there.
First, calm down and relaxxx~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Try not to brood too much, okay?
If you keep your chin up, things are sure to turn around."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Grandma.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, thanks, Accute!!
That took a bit of a load off my mind.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Everyone stumbles from time to time.
When that happens, look—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
One-two, one-two!
Time to get pumped up with practice, y'all~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"One-two, one-two!
One-two, one-two!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, lookin' good~.
Keep that momentum... and strike!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Cross counter!
Cross counter, cross counterrr!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Put your back into it more~...
We're aiming to be the world champion, after all~!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...!?
I-It was a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What a weird dream...
Boxing training just to learn how to dance...
and with a world champion, no less—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Well, who cares! It was surprisingly relaxing, and I feel like it blew all my fatigue away!
